methodology: Cited URLs that are gone for good and are no longer fetched by the document watcher (stocks/watch-sources.mjs). An entry is never deleted: the citations stay in the dossiers, sonar.source keeps the row with status 'retired' and the reason and date below, and every stored version and change event stays, so the evidence history remains explainable. Read by stocks/extract-sources.mjs (lib/sources.mjs applyRetirements). Retire only on evidence that the host will not come back — a wound-down issuer, a dead domain — never for a transient failure or a bot wall.
